intro: I plan the structure, prepare the numbers and make your case to the right lender. Then I stay across it as things change.

steps.label: Know the whole picture
steps.title: I look past the loan in front of me
steps.text: Your business, home and investments are connected. I listen first, then look at how company, trust and personal borrowing fit together, so the lending is built around what you're working towards.

steps.label: Know how lenders think
steps.title: I know what the lender needs to see
steps.text: Over 15 years in banking taught me how lenders decide. Before anything goes in, I work out what the lender will want to see, then prepare the numbers and your story to answer it.

steps.label: In your corner
steps.title: I tell you what I think, then see it through
steps.text: I won't hand you a list of options and leave you to it. I make the case, push where there's a sensible path, say so when something isn't possible, and stay involved as your plans change.
